author: KapjGames
body:
Hello my name is Kapj and I am writing this a request to unban me from the avicus network.
IGN: KapjGamesYT
Reason: Anti-Knockback
When: January 2 2015
Staff: cinammoncroc000
Why I want to get unbanned:
I would like to get unbanned because it has been a year and a half since I last went on avicus(banned). I was hacking at the time because I got ma at a person who was hacking so I used a client. After months passed, I saw the decrease of players on your server so I decided that I might right an appeal which I should have done last year. I was hoping to get unbanned because I wanted to come back and play DTM for the first time in a long time. So I beg of you that I would like to get unbanned to experience DTM once more. Also I don't hack anymore because I learned my lesson after getting banned from your server. :)
